comment: TEMPLATE of config/components.json (machine-independent). tools/configure.py expands ${ELAN_HOME} (elan home holding the official toolchains), ${LIGHT_LEAN} (the directory that contains env/tools/lean4export, default: the package's parent) and ${FASTVERIFY} into config/components.json and checks that every pinned file exists with its sha256. Pinned components of the fastverify package. Every binary is verified (sha256) and must start before a run; a mismatch or a binary that cannot start makes the run refuse (exit 2). Lean toolchains are the OFFICIAL release binaries (elan). Stage scripts are relative to the package root.

official_lean4export.version: lean4export v4.33.0 tag (commit 15f6055), built with Lake from env/tools/lean4export
leanexport bundled with the official Lean 4.36.0 release (lean4export 3.1.0); the 4.36 lake comparator uses exactly this exporter

leanprover/lean4:v4.36.0.comment: projects pinned to v4.36.0 are built by the official sandboxed lake build (build.sh declines: validated only for 4.33.1), exported by the release's leanexport (native exporter declines), checked like any other project; whole tree verified via toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v4.36.0.json
